facts.text: Macaulay Honors College students at Hunter College who are New York State residents receive a tuition scholarship for up to four years of undergraduate study.

sources.title: Prospective Students | Hunter College
sources.quote: All Honors College students receive a tuition scholarship* for up to four years of study towards an undergraduate degree, provided they are in good academic standing, are a New York State resident, and meet Macaulay requirements.
